name: Swiss Chard-Carrot Salad with Chickpeas, Dates, Almonds, Feta & Mint

instructions.primary_message: Place vinegar, honey, and salt in a small bowl, then stir to combine the pickling liquid. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup white wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp honey
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ bunches Swiss chard
3 lemons
9 medium carrots
1 small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Fold chard leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips and thinly slice the stems, keeping them separate. Add stems to the bowl with the pickling liquid and stir to combine; place leaves in a medium bowl. Set both aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, roughly chop almonds.
Once the skillet is hot, add almonds and cook, stirring constantly, until lightly browned, 2-3 minutes. Set aside to cool.
Zest and juice lemons into a large bowl.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl with the lemon along with oil, honey, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 shallot
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp honey
2 tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp coriander, ground
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Roughly chop dates. Add to the bowl.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl along with feta, pickled chard stems, and chard leaves. Toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with toasted almonds. Enjoy!
